title_en: In the Courtroom (14/20): A Lawyer Presents a Theft Case
note_en: 一…就… links two actions that follow each other instantly, like "as soon as… (right away)": 店员一查看监控录像，就认出了被告的脸 "as soon as the employee checked the footage, she recognized the defendant's face." Here 一 is not the number "one"; both 一 and 就 go right before their verbs, after any subject, so you say 店员一查看, not 一店员查看.
